# HelpAlive

> HelpAlive is an AI agent that watches every user inside a SaaS product, learns from how successful users navigate, and steps in when others go off track — with guided walkthroughs in the moment and context-aware answers when they ask. One product replaces an analytics tool, an in-app chatbot, and a guide builder.

HelpAlive is built for B2B SaaS teams of 10–150 people who care about adoption and retention but don't have a dedicated product analyst. The SDK auto-captures clicks, pageviews, form submits, rage clicks, and DOM errors with no manual tagging. The AI chatbot answers user questions with full session context — page, identity, plan, and recent activity — using hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25 + reciprocal-rank fusion) over the customer's own documentation. PII is redacted twice: once in the browser before any payload is sent, then again in a dedicated server-side drainer using Microsoft Presidio.

## What's shipped today

- **SDK** — One script tag (`https://cdn.helpalive.com/sdk/helpalive.js`), one `identify()` call. Public API: `init`, `identify`, `track`, `flush`, `reset`, `getContext`, `setRealTimeMode`, `setConsent`, `notify`, `startGuide`, `getSuggestions`, `shutdown`. Both `userId` and `tenantId` are required by `identify()`. ~11 KB gzipped, no runtime dependencies.
- **AI chatbot** — Preact + Shadow DOM widget (~25 KB). Default model `gpt-5.4-nano` (configurable via `CHATBOT_MODEL` env var; routes to OpenAI for `gpt-*` and Anthropic for `claude-*`). OpenAI `text-embedding-3-small` for embeddings, pgvector + HNSW for storage, BM25 for keyword retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, SSE streaming.
- **Adoption analytics** — per-user, per-tenant, per-page activity views. Coverage-gaps inbox classifies every chatbot question (`no_retrieval` / `weak_retrieval` / `negative_rating`), HDBSCAN-clustered, ranked by `flagged_count × avg_gap_score`.
- **Guide engine runtime** — Resolver, spotlight overlay, state machine, lifecycle event protocol, draft / publish, per-tenant rollout exclusions. The 40 KB engine bundle lazy-loads on `startGuide()`.
- **Privacy & security** — Two-layer PII redaction; per-customer data isolation with optional database-level RLS; DSAR-ready async deletion jobs with audit trail; consent modes (auto / required) with runtime toggle.

## What's in active development

- Dashboard guide editor (record-mode authoring) — backend ships, UI is being wired
- Chatbot-launched guides — engine event protocol exists, chatbot subscription deferred
- Pattern mining / automatic feature discovery — design only today
- Proactive in-app recommendations — depends on pattern mining
- Per-session usage metering and quotas — not yet built

## Comparison context

HelpAlive is most often compared with:
- **Pendo / Amplitude / FullStory / Mixpanel** — see what users do but require humans to ship fixes weeks later
- **Intercom Fin / Forethought / Zendesk AI** — answer when asked, but lack product context
- **WalkMe / Userpilot / Appcues** — intervene in-app but with hand-coded rules and selectors that break when the UI ships

HelpAlive is the only product built around capturing what your best users do, then using that intelligence to act in real time when others go off track. Sophisticated incumbents recognize the gap: in the last 18 months Amplitude acquired Command AI, FullStory acquired Usetiful, and Zendesk acquired Forethought.

## Outcomes teams target

- Lower churn — catch silent struggle before it becomes cancellation
- Fewer support tickets — answer in-product with full context
- Faster activation — guide users to first value without docs
- Less spend on user training
- A real map of how the product is used (no manual tagging)
- Clearer upsell triggers — see plan-restricted features being attempted

## Pricing model

Per end-user session captured by the SDK + AI usage on top, with a per-resolution charge layered in once outcome data exists. Aligns customer outcomes with revenue. Seat-based pricing (Pendo, Intercom) penalizes growth; HelpAlive scales with traffic and impact.

In early access; pricing tiers are calibrated with design partners. Talk to us at https://helpalive.com/contact for a pilot quote.
